JOYSTAR Paris Girls' Bike - Sizes 14" to 20"
Elegant, safe, and built for fun, the JOYSTAR Paris Girls' Bike combines a timeless vintage look with reliable modern engineering. Designed for girls aged 3 to 10, the Paris helps young riders build confidence and coordination while exploring their world in style.

Vintage elegance for the modern explorer: The JOYSTAR Paris in Deep Pink.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Crafted with safety as the priority, the Paris features a dual-braking system and a stable frame designed for effortless pedaling and control."
Superior Safety Systems
The JOYSTAR Paris features a sturdy high-tensile steel frame with a low stand-over height, ensuring children can mount and dismount with ease. To provide maximum stopping power, it is equipped with a dual-braking system: a front handbrake for developing braking skills and an intuitive rear coaster brake for easy stopping.

Dual-braking gives little riders the control they need to ride with confidence.

Key Features & Benefits

Growth-Ready: The adjustable saddle and stem allow the bike to grow alongside your child for a perfect fit year after year.

Effortless Riding: Low gearing and high-quality bearings make pedaling easy for smaller legs.

Classic Style: Comes standard with a charming front basket, a bell, and custom DIY decals.

Full Protection: A chain guard keeps fingers safe and ensures clothes stay clean during every trip.

Quick & Easy Assembly
We make it simple to start the adventure. The JOYSTAR Paris arrives 85% pre-assembled. With the included tools and clear instructions, most parents have the bike ready for the sidewalk in approximately 20 minutes.

Easy Setup: Get your JOYSTAR Paris ready for the road in minutes.

See It In Action

Watch: Building memories on the JOYSTAR Paris.

Our Guarantee
JOYSTAR is committed to quality, offering a peace-of-mind guarantee with every bike:

The Frame (Lifetime): Steel frames are guaranteed against manufacturing defects for the life of the original owner.

Secure Delivery: Most orders ship within 48 hours with standard delivery in 3-7 business days.
